Class CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut>

java.lang.Object
io.parsley.CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut>
Type Parameters:
KIn - the input key type
VIn - the input value type
KOut - the forwarded key type
VOut - the forwarded value type
Enclosing class:
CausalProcessors
public static final class CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> extends Object
Builder for a CausalProcessorSupplier. A buffer store (via addBufferStore(String, CausalBufferLimit)) and at least one CausalBuffer (via addBuffer(CausalBuffer)/addBuffers(Collection)) are required; Parsley's own configuration is optional.

  • Method Details

    • addBufferStore

      public CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> addBufferStore(String name, CausalBufferLimit limit)
      Declares the buffer state store and its eviction limit — the required Kafka-Streams-style pairing of a store name with how it is sized, mirroring Stores.

      name is the state-store namespace: the frontier store is name + "-frontier", the held-record buffer store name + "-buffer", and the candidate index name + "-candidate-index". These name the backing changelog topics, so keep name stable across restarts, and unique per causal processor sharing a topology.

      Parameters:
      name - the state-store namespace
      limit - the buffer eviction trigger — how long to wait for a record's dependencies before forwarding it anyway (out of causal order, logged and counted by the violation metric)
      Returns:
      this builder

    • addBuffer

      public CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> addBuffer(CausalBuffer<KIn,VIn> buffer)
      Registers a causal source: its topic name and the serdes the buffer (de)serialises held records from that topic with. Required for every input topic this processor will see; the topic's stable UUID is resolved from the broker automatically at startup.
      Parameters:
      buffer - the source topic and its serdes; must not be null
      Returns:
      this builder

      public CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> addBuffers(Collection<CausalBuffer<KIn,VIn>> buffers)
      Registers several causal sources at once. Equivalent to calling addBuffer(CausalBuffer) for each.
      Parameters:
      buffers - the source buffers; must not be null
      Returns:
      this builder

    • addBuffers

      Registers several topics that share one serde pair — the convenience for the homogeneous case, mirroring a single stream(topics, Consumed.with(key, value)).

    • withConfigs

      public CausalProcessors.Builder<KIn,VIn,KOut,VOut> withConfigs(Map<String,Object> configs)
      Sets Parsley's own configuration from a map of key/value pairs, mirroring how Kafka Streams configuration is supplied. Keys are overlaid on top of any parsley.properties classpath resource. See ParsleyConfig for the recognised keys.
      Parameters:
      configs - the configuration entries; values are recorded as their string form
      Returns:
      this builder
